text:
maria: heads up — I just hit an odd one in Console Insights. after rapidly switching orgs, the metrics panel briefly showed another org's charts. repro steps: 1) open console, 2) switch org via topbar twice quickly, 3) open Insights. screenshot: https://redwood.s3/anon/insights-shadow.png
ben: can repro. also noticed quotas badge on the header showed the previous org's commit count for ~3s. weird timing window.
anya: suspecting a caching race. last routing change added route-affinity caching on the client for perf (PR #4123) — might not invalidate when `x-org-id` flips during a quick UI switch.
olaf: logs from the proxy show stale map entries. example log:
```
INFO route_cache: key=SESSION:xyz123 -> {org: "org-b", affinity: "rack-7"}
DEBUG request: headers={"x-org-id": "org-a", "x-session-id": "xyz123"}
```
so the cache returned org-b mapping even though the incoming header was org-a.
ben: quick mitigation idea: on org switch emit a `org_switch` event client-side that forces `route_cache.invalidate(session)` before sending the next page load. also send a `X-Org-Switch: 1` header for server-side detection and safety.
maria: agree. we should also add a server-side guard: verify cached mapping org == incoming `x-org-id` and fall back to fresh lookup if mismatched. that should prevent any data bleed even if client fails to invalidate.
anya: proposed rollout: 1) client patch to emit `org_switch` + `X-Org-Switch` header (canary UI build to 5% of prod), 2) server-side guard + telemetry event `org_switch_mismatch` (canary on prod-2), 3) backend patch to include org id in cache key (longer term).
ben: adding small code snippet for server guard:
```
cached = route_cache.get(session)
if cached and cached.org != req.headers['x-org-id']:
    telemetry.emit('org_switch_mismatch', {cached_org: cached.org, req_org: req.headers['x-org-id']})
    cached = None  # force fresh route lookup
```
anya: I'll pick up the e2e tests: add a fast org-switch scenario that asserts no cross-org metrics visible, and a unit test for cache key including org.
maria: created issue #5123 and attached steps + screenshot. assigning to @anya for tests, @ben for client quickfix, @olaf for server guard.
deploy-bot: deploy started: ui v1.34.2 -> canary on prod-2 (5%), backend api v2.18.0 -> canary on prod-2.
olaf: ran an ad-hoc DB query for requests where telemetry.org != request.header.x_org_id in last 24h — found 23 hits (likely within the switching window). I'll post the query and rows separately.
ben: once canary looks clean we should push to 100% and add an alert to catch `org_switch_mismatch` > 5 spikes/hr.
maria: thanks everyone. follow-ups: add regression alert, update runbook, and schedule a small postmortem if we find evidence of real data access outside intended org boundaries. :thumbsup:
